channel.title: Pier & Point · San Francisco Public Safety Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for San Francisco Public Safety Building (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · San Francisco Public Safety Building: Added 2 photos taken on site on September 27, 2026.
item.description: Added 2 photos taken on site on September 27, 2026. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · San Francisco Public Safety Building: The April 16, 2015 grand opening is now cited to SF Public Works' press release dated that day (it reports the ribbon-cutting and that the campus became fully operational), where before only a pre-event advisory was cited. The construction start is now cited to both SF Public Works (October 2011) and ENR (underway by September 22, 2011). The building permit is called new construction, not alterations. LEED Gold is credited to SF Public Works and the architect, since SFPD's page only says LEED. The contractor and construction-manager names and the component square footages now cite the architect's page and ENR. The permit cost entry no longer says the cost was revised, and the aerial photo credit no longer says 'from a departing flight'.
item.description: The April 16, 2015 grand opening is now cited to SF Public Works' press release dated that day (it reports the ribbon-cutting and that the campus became fully operational), where before only a pre-event advisory was cited. The construction start is now cited to both SF Public Works (October 2011) and ENR (underway by September 22, 2011). The building permit is called new construction, not alterations. LEED Gold is credited to SF Public Works and the architect, since SFPD's page only says LEED. The contractor and construction-manager names and the component square footages now cite the architect's page and ENR. The permit cost entry no longer says the cost was revised, and the aerial photo credit no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: SF Public Works, 2015-04-16 (https://sfpublicworks.org/project/san-francisco-police-department%E2%80%99s-new-headquarters-unveiled); SF Public Works, Public Safety Building project page (https://sfpublicworks.org/project/public-safety-building); Engineering News-Record, 2011-09-22 (https://www.enr.com/articles/10300-construction-underway-on-san-franciscos-public-safety-building); Mark Cavagnero Associates, San Francisco Public Safety Campus (https://www.cavagnero.com/project/san-francisco-public-safety-campus/); DBI permit 201110066246 (https://dbiweb02.sfgov.org/dbipts/?page=Permit&PermitNumber=201110066246).
